{{Quote|Transport Renegade here to reload you when ready, Alpha 1|''Renegade''|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
'''''Renegade''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ''Renegade'' took part on the first [[Attack on ZA-13|skirmish]] on [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[ZA-13]]. It was used to reload the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] with warheads when they run out and needed to reload.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Renegade'' is a transport ship that appears in ''Star Wars:TIE Fighter'' at Battle 8 Combat 2. When the player runs out of missiles, the ''Renegade'' will appear to reload your craft.
